   * Creates a function returning a Promise that resolves to the property value.
   * 
   * target - The object containing the property (e.g., window.DERSTANDARD)
   * propName - The name of the property to watch (e.g., 'globalServices')
   */
  function waitForProperty(target, propName) {
    let resolver;
    const promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
      resolver = resolve;
    });
    let currentValue = target[propName];
    // If the property was already assigned before this setup, resolve immediately
    if (currentValue !== undefined) {
      resolver(currentValue);
    }
    Object.defineProperty(target, propName, {
      configurable: true,
      enumerable: true,
      get() {
        return currentValue;
      },
      set(value) {
        currentValue = value;
        resolver(value);
      }
    });
    
    return function getPropertyAsync() {
      return promise;
    };
  }

  window.DERSTANDARD = window.DERSTANDARD || {};
  window.DERSTANDARD.getGlobalServices = waitForProperty(window.DERSTANDARD, 'globalServices');
